sleep_goodnight.name: GoodNight
sleep_goodnight.key: Per 2 capsules: 5 mg melatonin, 500 mg L-tryptophan, 300 mg lemon balm, 200 mg L-theanine, 120 mg hops, 100 mg valerian, 40 mg vitamin B6
sleep_goodnight.src: GoodNight sell sheet ND521 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, read into scratchpad labels/labels.json): per 2 capsules vitamin B6 (as P5P) 40 mg, L-tryptophan 500 mg, lemon balm 4:1 extract 300 mg, L-theanine 200 mg, hops 4:1 extract 120 mg, valerian extract (0.8% valerenic acids) 100 mg, melatonin 5 mg; 30 servings; directions 1 or 2 capsules one hour before bedtime; label caution: pregnant, nursing, SSRIs or MAOIs, may cause drowsiness. Same amounts in products DB R153 (5 switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 (R153 60C).

sleep_stress_calm.name: Stress Essentials Calm
sleep_stress_calm.key: 550 mg GABA and 200 mg L-theanine per 2 capsules
sleep_stress_calm.src: products DB R405 (Designs for Health switch chart label check vs NeuroCalm, catalog ND143 10/1/26): GABA 550 mg, L-theanine 200 mg per 2 capsules; directions two capsules daily; size 60C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). The 2026-11-02 sleep-hour blast calls the theanine Suntheanine; the DB label read does not, so the sheet does not print it.

sleep_theanine_pro.name: L-Theanine Pro
sleep_theanine_pro.src: products DB R2123 (Thorne switch chart, direct match vs Thorne Theanine, catalog ND143 10/1/26): L-theanine 200 mg per capsule; directions one capsule twice daily; size 60C (ND144 price list 10/1/26).

sleep_mag_calm_pro.name: Mag Calm Pro
sleep_mag_calm_pro.key: Per scoop: 200 mg magnesium, 2 g myo-inositol, 500 mg taurine, 100 mg L-theanine (Suntheanine), 5 mg vitamin B6
sleep_mag_calm_pro.src: Mag Calm Pro sell sheet ND1075 Rev. 11/24 (labels.json): per scoop (4.13 g) vitamin B6 (as P5P) 5 mg, magnesium (as dimagnesium malate) 200 mg, myo-inositol 2 g, taurine 500 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg; about 60 servings, 247.8 g; directions 1 scoop in 6 oz water 1-2 times daily. Same amounts in products DB R2122 (Metagenics chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26).
